items.description: MISP contains an authorization and scope flaw in the ObjectReference model's captureReference method. items.title: CVE-2026-133157
items.description:
flowintel contains a CSV injection vulnerability in its audit log CSV export functionality. Attacker-influenced text recorded in audit logs could be interpreted as spreadsheet formulas when an administrator opened the exported CSV file in a spreadsheet application.

The vulnerable behavior allowed an attacker who could influence audit log content (for example by generating network traffic that is captured and logged) to embed formula-like strings (such as =CMD() or =HYPERLINK()) into audit entries. When the resulting CSV export was opened in a spreadsheet application, these strings could be executed as formulas, potentially leading to data exfiltration, data manipulation, or execution of further malicious actions within the spreadsheet context.

- An attacker must be able to influence content that is recorded in flowintel audit logs.

items.title: CVE-2026-133116
items.description: Termix 1.7.0 before 26.11.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to write files outside the export directory via crafted usernames. Attackers can self-register with a username containing ../ segments and request POST /database/export to plant attacker-controlled SQLite files in writable directories, enabling disk exhaustion.

items.title: CVE-2026-133115
items.description: Redmine 6.1.0 before 6.1.6 and 7.0.0 before 7.0.3 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that lets OAuth clients exceed token scope during project creation. A client with only project-creation scope can set is_public, enabled_module_names and inherit_members, making projects public and granting parent-project members subproject access.

items.title: CVE-2026-133114

items.title: CVE-2026-133113
items.description: Gogs through 0.14.4 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows collaborators with write access to push to protected branches by merging pull requests. items.title: CVE-2026-133112

items.title: CVE-2026-132858

items.title: CVE-2026-110337
items.description:
The Strava datasource plugin's resource handler POST /strava-api forwards a client-supplied endpoint string, and its query parameters, to the Strava API (https://www.strava.com/api/v3/<endpoint>) without validation.

When the datasource is not in OAuth pass-through mode, the request is made with the access token stored on the datasource, not the caller's identity. Grafana authorises plugin resource calls only on the datasources:query permission, which Viewers have by default. Any such caller could therefore request any Strava API path the connected account's OAuth grant allows, for example athlete/clubs or routes/{id}, and read the response.

The plugin's frontend (stravaApi.ts) only needs a fixed set of paths: athlete, athlete/activities, activities/{id}, activities/{id}/streams and segments/{id}.

Requests to Strava are GET only, so the issue is read-only.

Affected: plugin versions 1.

items.title: CVE-2026-22311
items.description:
The failed-login limiter of the JTL-Wawi
synchronisation interface of JTL-Shop derives the client identity from the
client-controlled X-Forwarded-For header and counts requests without credentials as failed
logins. An unauthenticated remote attacker can block the synchronisation
between JTL-Shop and JTL-Wawi with a few requests and repeat this
indefinitely, so that orders are no longer handed over to JTL-Wawi. No data is disclosed
and no code is executed.

items.title: CVE-2026-125061
items.description:
The administration page "Offene
Bestellungen" (open orders) of the JTL PayPal Checkout plugin for JTL-Shop outputs the
customer name of pending orders without output encoding. A registered
customer (free self-registration) can submit an HTML-entity-encoded name, which is
decoded to markup when the billing address of an order is written. If
the PayPal payment is left unfinished, the order is listed on the page and the
name is rendered as markup in the browser of an administrator who opens
the page. The script code runs with the privileges of that administrator
and can, for example, create a new administrator account. Guest orders are
not affected, because the name is encoded again.

items.title: CVE-2026-125060
items.description:
The checkout of JTL-Shop stores the delivery address
ID submitted by the customer in the session and adopts it into the order
without verifying that the address belongs to the ordering customer. A remote
attacker with access to the checkout, including a guest, can thereby attach
the delivery address of another customer to their own order. Name and
address of the other customer, and depending on the shop configuration
further contact data, then appear in the order confirmation and customer
account. As the IDs are sequential, addresses can be enumerated. Goods may
also be shipped to the wrong address.

items.title: CVE-2026-123972
items.description: The WP-Slimbox2 Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.3.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires a logged-in user, typically an administrator, to click the attacker's image link in the comment; however, because unmoderated comments appear in the WordPress moderation queue where administrators routinely interact with them, the moderation gate does not meaningfully prevent exploitation. Successful exploitation causes the attacker's own account to receive the complete Administrator role.

items.title: CVE-2026-123971
items.description: The Slimbox Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'el.title (HTML-decoded title attribute of a stored <a rel^=lightbox> element)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires a companion plugin such as bbPress that permits low-privileged users to store anchor elements with arbitrary title and rel attributes, as WordPress core comment handling does not preserve rel on anchor tags by default.

items.title: CVE-2026-123969
items.description: The Fancy Lightbox plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.0.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation without administrator interaction requires that the attacker first have one comment approved so that a subsequent payload comment is auto-published; the injected script only executes when a user clicks the malicious image link inside the comment. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

items.title: CVE-2026-123968
items.description: The Slimbox plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment (anchor title within comment HTML)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.0.8 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. WordPress core comment KSES permits unauthenticated commenters to post anchor elements with href and title attributes, so an entity-encoded payload stored in the title attribute survives sanitization verbatim; the browser then decodes the entities when populating the DOM .title property, and the Slimbox library's jQuery .html() caption sink renders it as executable HTML.

items.title: CVE-2026-123058
items.description:
The web installer of JTL-Shop executes its
state-changing installation tasks without checking whether the shop is already
installed, and was not removed or locked after the installation. An unauthenticated
remote attacker who can reach the installer directory can supply their own
database credentials, create administrator and synchronisation accounts and
overwrite the shop configuration. This can lead to a full takeover of
the shop, including code execution on the server.

items.title: CVE-2026-115677
items.description:
Buffer Copy without Checking Size of Input ('Classic Buffer Overflow') vulnerability in AirTies Kablosuz İletişim Sanayi ve Dış Ticaret A.Ş. Air 5444 allows Overflow Buffers.

This issue affects Air 5444: through 2026-11-19.
NOTE: The vendor was contacted and it was learned that the product is not supported.

items.title: CVE-2026-113458
items.description: Mattermost versions 11.10.x <= 11.10.2, 11.11.x <= 11.11.1, 11.7.x <= 11.7.12 fail to validate the format of configured database connection strings before redacting them, which allows a party with access to a generated Support Packet or server log files to recover plaintext database credentials when the connection string is configured in a non-URL format.. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00783

items.title: CVE-2026-82950
items.description:
The device only supports Wi-Fi protocols vulnerable to
deauthentication attacks (WEP/WPA/WPA2). Should any event which would typically
be logged to the user’s mobile device (such as arming or disarming the alarm or
any tamper events) be incurred whilst the device is temporarily disconnected
from its Wi-Fi network (such as via a deauthentication attack), those alerts
will not be sent even after connection is regained.

items.title: CVE-2026-82949
items.description:
The static codes used for information transmission
throughout the 433.92 MHz system of the Guardian 2 system allow an attacker in
proximity to monitor the movements of users inside the premises where the
sensors are set up. This is further aided by the fact that codes transmitted
reveal sensor type, although sensor location cannot be inferred from this
traffic alone.

items.title: CVE-2026-82948
items.description:
The Guardian 2 alarm unit lacks a mechanism to
authenticate control commands sent over 433.92 MHz, which allows an attacker to
replay the static commands to impersonate activity.  The attacker can also disarm or arm the
system at will if a Nexsmart keypad (product link) is in use, thus compromising
the functionality of the alarm system completely.

items.title: CVE-2026-133001
items.description:
FlowIntel contains an authorization flaw in its duplicate alert ingestion logic. When a duplicate alert is received and its content is updated, the ownership and visibility scope fields (owner user and owner organization) were not refreshed to reflect the connector's current scope. As a result, an alert that was originally created under a broader visibility scope retained that broader scope even after the connector's scope was narrowed or changed.

This means that users or organizations that should no longer have visibility into a given alert could continue to access it, because the stale ownership fields were never updated during the duplicate-update path. The issue affected all duplicate updates, including those involving alerts in terminal review states and those recovered from uniqueness conflicts.

- Unauthorized disclosure of security alert content to users or orga
